main_text.p: dem posse,veluti,L. Titius cum capere potuerit, heres esto. L. in tempus, 62.D.de heredib. instit. Eodem modo dicamus, testatoris hanc fuisse sententiam, postumus cũ suus erit, heres esto. Quocirca ne rumpi deinceps hoc casu testamenta possent, hoc est, eo casu, quo qui testamenti tempore alienus erat, mortis tempore suus heres reperitur: haberētcꝑ testatores certā, qua hunc casum comprehenderent, formulam, C. Aquilius Gallus Iurisconsultus certam quandā composuit, quā in consuetudinem induxit, quemadmodum actionum omnium legitimarum formulas Iurisconsulti concipere solebant uadimoniorum, stipulationum, litium, exceptionum, satisdationum, acceptilationum: quo ipso in genere huius eiusdem nobilem illam uidemus, quę ex ipsius nomine Aquiliana dicta est. induxit igitur in consuetudinem, inquit Ceruidius, non ius nouum, sed formulam iuris antiquire[?] tinendi atqꝑ ufurpandi, quo licebat, ne potes postumos heredes hoc casu instituere, si filius testatore uiuo morere

page.notes: Running head and page number read as printed; the final digit of the page number is slightly unclear, read as 3. "antiquire" is uncertain and may be a worn or misprinted word. The catchword "tur," is set at the right below the last line. Marginal reference "62.D.de heredib. instit." is in the left margin beside the second line. The lines in the text column have no visible indents, so the text is treated as one running paragraph.
